content.text: Bringing health through food to as many people as possible News and Stories from Ireland Press release December 22, 2025 22 Dec. 2025 84% Of FoodCloud’s Charity Partners Experiencing Increase in People Needing Support 2025 Story Press release Press release Transparent reporting Proudly British Oats Wimbledon Spectator British Oats Investment More than 100 years of supporting health From our first yogurts in pharmacies, we have certainly come a long way in over 100 years. Our products, ranging from yogurts and plant-based products, to waters, and specialized nutrition products, are now part of everyday life in millions of households. We're proud to be present in over 120 countries around the world, making healthy eating and drinking accessible to as many people as possible. 89% of products sold belong to healthy categories 120+ countries where our products are sold 90,000 Danoners around the world CONTRIBUTING TO A HEALTHIER WORLD Our product categories Essential Dairy & Plant-Based products Waters Specialized Nutrition Dairy and Plant-based Products Water Brands Specialized Nutrition Careers My mission is to guarantee the stability and preserve the minerality of this water, from the source to the bottle. Maud Freynet Laboratory Quality Technician for La Salvetat Danone Impact Journey As part of our Renew Danone strategy, we have developed a sustainability roadmap based on three interconnected pillars: Health, Nature, and People & Communities. For each of these pillars, the company has set new priorities and objectives for the future, focusing on the areas where Danone can bring the most value.
